data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1: Test file path explicit — tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh. RED test specs: (a) missing .reconciler-phase-gate → exit 2 + stderr 'phase not advanced: phase=<N> gate_missing'; (b) phase mismatch (gate='bootstrap-strict', requested 'bootstrap-throttle') → exit 2; (c) match → exit 0 silent; (d) ops marker (.reconciler-phase-gate.ops JSON Lines) phase match → exit 0; (e) malformed JSON in .ops → fail-closed exit 2 with diagnostic.
